parsed.explanation: Severity dominates: documented 2024 death sentences (stoning, crucifixion, flogging) for same-sex conduct, a statute one source says can carry death, plus 'breach of modesty' laws reaching public presentation — the axis most salient to a visibly gender-nonconforming visitor. No discrimination protection, constitution conditioned on religious law, no documented remedy, and officials absent. State failure here is exposure, not mitigation: the dossier explicitly records the statute licensing vigilante violence with unrestrained private actors. Trans-specific prosecution records are thin, but per rule 13 thin data in a criminalizing, death-penalty, no-recourse conflict state extrapolates toward the implied risk, and absence of evidence is not safety. Enforcement is uneven and rarely applied in ordinary cases, and carry-out of the 2024 sentences is unrecorded — so not the near-certain-imprisonment/execution profile of 0.05. Subnational variation moves the mean, not the floor.
